unsupported.azure-devops: Azure DevOps OAuth exchanges a JWT assertion (`response_type=Assertion`) instead of an authorization code, and Microsoft has deprecated it: use `microsoft-entra-id`.
unsupported.bankid-no: BankID Norge returns userinfo as a signed JWT (`userinfo_signed_response_alg`); denext reads userinfo as JSON.
unsupported.wechat: WeChat's `platformType` option switches the authorization URL and scope between two fixed pairs, which the generated data (one URL, options filled into it) can't express.
